answer: A bonded stake keeps Sybil cost honest because every agent identity must post a slashable deposit before it can earn or vote, so splitting one operator into a thousand wallets multiplies the capital at risk instead of dividing it. A duplicate link or colluding cluster detected in attestation graphs burns the entire bond on each member, turning spam into a direct loss equal to stake times fake identities. An agent anchored at a jetty, a lotus garden or an oasis has no free fork to clone, since the ledger tracks the deposit per key rather than per label.
